Author: WowLookThatGuy
Name: Best Gear All
Description: Updates saved gearsets using FFXIV's Recommended Gear calculation. Includes background and traditional updaters, Armoury Chest organization, displaced-gear cleanup, and a clickable server-info-bar status shortcut for starting Background Update.
Punchline: Update gearsets with Recommended Gear and organize the Armoury Chest.

Author: WowLookThatGuy
Name: InNeedQueue
Description: Role-based roulette monitoring with priorities, random queue delay, daily reward filtering, and five-minute presence checks.
Punchline: Queue selected roulettes when your role is in need.

Author: WowLookThatGuy
Name: Retainer Gear Optimizer
Description:
Cycles through every retainer at a summoning bell and distributes gear from your main inventory (Inventory 1-4) across all of them. Combat (DoW/DoM) retainers get the highest total item level; gathering (MIN/BTN/FSH) retainers get the highest total Gathering and Perception, counting HQ bonuses and melded materia. Gear a retainer drops when it's upgraded can be passed down to another retainer in the same run, and no retainer ever gets worse in any slot. The armoury chest is ignored.

Open a summoning bell, then use /rgo start or the Start button in /rgo. Enable Dry run in /rgo to preview the plan without moving anything.
Punchline: Distribute the gear in your inventory across all your retainers: highest item level for combat, best Gathering and Perception for gatherers.

Author: WowLookThatGuy
Name: Retainer Venture Assigner
Description: Open the retainer list at a summoning bell and let the plugin pick and assign the optimal venture for each retainer. Rewards mode maximizes expected item value (Universalis prices with vendor-price fallback); EXP mode maximizes retainer experience. Use /rva to open the window.
Punchline: Assigns the best venture to every retainer, for loot or for EXP.
